## R Markdown
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

```


There are two potential methods to explore:

1. Importing the txt file into a dataframe using a specific delineator ("|" or width), then extract values from the dataframe into a table. 

```{r}



delim <- read_delim("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ifi-ony/607_Project_1/refs/heads/main/tournamentinfo.txt", delim = "|")

lines <- read_lines("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ifi-ony/607_Project_1/refs/heads/main/tournamentinfo.txt")

linef <- data.frame(lines)


```


2. Processing the data in the import itself by searching using recurring patterns in the data within the import statement (potentially using grep command).
